EBMW.description: Concrete Wall End Rebar Design Method (EBMW). One EBMW entry per wall is keyed by WALL ID and holds an ITEMS list, each entry a per-story rebar design-method setting selected by ID (story id) and WALLID.

ITEMS.description: Concrete Wall end rebar design method items. Each element defines the end rebar and boundary-element end rebar design methods for one story/wall combination.

ID.description: Story id (storid) that this item applies to.

WALLID.description: Wall id (wallid) that this item applies to.

EBARDESIGNMETHOD.description: End rebar design method (integer code stored as iEBarDesignMethod).

BEEBARDESIGNMETHOD.description: Boundary element end rebar design method (integer code stored as iBEEbarDesignMethod).
